## Rule (decoded 2026-06-30 — frame/template render; supersedes the old "memorized lookup")

Generator `external/ARC-GEN/tasks/task_776ffc46.py`: 5–6 sprites on a 20×20 grid, each one of 10 hardcoded shapes. Sprite#0 has a color C∈{2,3} and sits inside a **complete 7×7 gray (color-5) frame**; all other sprites are blue (color 1). `idxs[1]=idxs[0]` guarantees ≥1 blue copy of the key form. **Output recolors every blue sprite whose SHAPE == the framed key's shape to color C.** Decoy colored shapes that are NOT inside a complete frame must be ignored — TR3 proves it: only the green 3×3 inside the full 7×7 frame is the key; the decoy `33`/`3333` fragments in incomplete gray are left alone. Frame is FIXED 7×7; all corpus grids are 20×20.

**Bar (manifest, live-rechecked 2026-07-11):** cost **4460**, owner **Boladi**, sha256
`b2c1867a3daee66808dbf4ad64acc64a617b140393acfbaefbac40d2dc3652e8`, updated_utc 2026-07-11T00:40:30Z
(`Team_Submission/Backend/manifest.csv`; local oracle `Team_Best_Onnx/task182.onnx`). profile_real_cost
`--arcgen 266` = static = **4460** (memory 4142 + params 318). Byte-equal-vs-oracle is the gold gate.

**Cost model (verified in `neurogolf_utils.py`):** memory = SUM of intermediate-tensor **bytes**
(dtype-dependent; input/output free); params = initializer **element count** (dtype-FREE:
`sum(prod(dims))`); `calculate_memory` re-runs `strict_mode` shape-inference and returns None on any
`dim<=0` / `dim_param` — so a stripped-value_info graph with a data-dependent Slice fails scoring
(value_info MUST be preserved for the dynamic crop).

**Graph `conv shape-hash` (Boladi 4460):** (1) **Frame localize, 1D:** `Einsum(input, v_w9=onehot[ch5])`
-> row profile `v_t0`/col profile `v_t5` [1,30]; ROW uses paired-add `v_t0[0:14]+v_t0[6:20]`->ArgMax
(complete-frame robust vs incomplete-gray decoys), COL uses direct ArgMax. (2) **Crop key:** dynamic
`Slice(input, [2,r+1,c+1], [4,r+6,c+6])` -> `v_t13 [1,2,5,5]` (channels 2,3 = colours {2,3});
`ReduceMax`spatial->colour `v_t14 [1,2,1,1]`, `ReduceMax`channel->shape mask `v_t15 [1,1,5,5]`.
(3) **Shape hash via Conv:** `v_w12 [1,10,5,5]` (25 random weights on ch1, 9 zero channels) hashes
every blue window -> `v_t17` FLOAT **[1,1,16,16]**; `v_w13` hashes the key -> `v_t18 [1,1,1,1]`;
`Equal`-> anchors BOOL `v_t19 [1,1,16,16]` -> Cast UINT8 `v_t20`. (4) **Stamp:** `QLinearConv(v_t20,
flip(key))` paints the shape at each anchor -> `v_t21 [1,1,20,20]` UINT8 -> Cast BOOL `v_t22` -> Pad
-> `v_t24 [1,1,30,30]` BOOL. (5) `Where(v_t24, colour_vec, input)`.

**MY STAGED RUNG: `task182_int32coords_padaxes` cost 4425 (byte-equal, -35).** sha256
`a7afb43241238867b20b9d29341c41263ca1a4d1c28b9063fb8de9310455e03c`. Byte-equal micro-compression of
the 4460 parent (NO rule change): INT32-narrow the dynamic-crop coordinate tensors (`v_t7..v_t12`,
consts `v_w0/v_w7/v_w3`; ArgMax int64 -> Cast int32) = -32 B memory; opset-18 axes-Pad on the colour
Pad (v_w14 8-elem -> pads=[2,6], axes reuse shared `v_w2`) = -4 params; +2 params for int32 add
consts. Gates: visible 267/267; ab --n 2000 vs Team_Best byte_equal=True (2267/2267, div=0); truth
--n 2000 = 2000/2000; profile 4425 (mem 4110 + params 315). ng_safety WARN (QLinearConv x86 family,
inherited from the live parent -> probe is a formality). staged_candidates/task182_int32coords_padaxes_cost4425/.

**FORCED-COMPONENT FLOOR (why 4460/4425 is a near-floor for the correct rule):**

| component | bytes | forced because |
|---|---:|---|
| `v_t17` hash map FLOAT [1,1,16,16] | 1024 | Exact shape match needs a per-position score. The ONLY cheap route is `Conv` on the FREE F32 one-hot input (a UINT8/QLinearConv match needs a blue plane = 3600 B Einsum >> 1024). Conv emits F32. Anchors span the full [0,15]^2 placement range (hand-authored train/test use rows/cols 0 and 15) -> 16x16 forced. **Irreducible.** |
| `v_t24` output mask BOOL [1,1,30,30] | 900 | Per-pixel `Where` over the 30x30 output. BOOL(1B) is smallest; a 20x20 mask can't broadcast to 30x30, and cropping the output forces a per-channel background Pad on a [1,10,*] F32 plane. **Irreducible.** |
| render tail: anchors 256+256 + stamp 400+400 | 1312 | Equal->BOOL(256)->Cast UINT8(256) for QLinearConv; QLinearConv->UINT8 20x20(400)->Cast BOOL(400). Every dtype is already 1-byte; reorders/merges all profile HIGHER. |
| read-key: crop 200 + shape 100 + profiles 240 + row-detect 168 + colour 40 + small | ~750 | 2-channel 5x5 crop (colour+shape double-duty), two 1D frame profiles, load-bearing row paired-add (row direct-ArgMax = visible 266/267). |

**WALL VERDICT — 4425 is my staged rung; 4460's paradigm is a near-floor.** The two dominant tensors
(1024 hash + 900 mask = 1924) are forced by (a) exact match on the free F32 input and (b) the dense
30x30 recolor output. Three deeper cuts tested & DEAD (`hard_records/`): 14x14 hash crop (visible
265/267, edge placements), sparse Conv weight (checker + sanitize reject), row direct-ArgMax (266/267).
No F32 intermediate can be narrowed (Conv/Einsum/Slice emit F32; a Cast adds a charged copy). Only the
non-forced small-int coordinate path + one pad were shaveable (-35).

**Pass-2 (2026-07-12) — library-confirmed + empirically measured the 1024 hash floor.** Library facts
(neurogolf_lesson_facts) independently confirm this paradigm: #942 "convolve on the FREE one-hot input,
don't materialize channel planes"; #930 "1D profile hash is unsafe for contained-object disambiguation,
use 2D"; #954 "sliding hash kernel has an interior cost optimum" (k=5 is it — idx4 is 5 cells wide, so
k<5 collides; the crop already pins the output plane at the 16×16 anchor floor so params=C·k·k minimise
at k=5). **Measured the linchpin:** the blue-plane extraction that EVERY UINT8/QLinearConv-integer-match
alternative needs profiles at **9021** (`Einsum(input,blue_sel)→[1,30,30] F32 = 3600` + copies) — the
blue plane ALONE (≥3600) is 3.5× the whole F32 hash map (1024). **Op-algebra floor:** the match must read
the input; the input is F32-free or a ≥3600 charged copy; every spatial op on the free F32 input
(Conv/Einsum/MatMul) emits F32; the map must be 16×16 (anchor range [0,15]²) ⇒ **1024 F32 is irreducible.**
*Caveat: my 5448 "floor" was wrong twice; I claim "floor" as "no cheaper correct graph found across the
conv + bit-pack + extraction-match paradigms and 4 concrete cuts" — but the op-algebra argument above
plus the forced 900 output mask rule out ~1200 with confidence.*

## Don't-do log

- **Assume one-hot F32 input forces a box-conv shape hash (the old 7649 proof):** WRONG — bit-pack the blue channel to per-row integers (`Einsum·pow2`) and match in the integer domain; no spatial F32 plane needed. (bo_ng_cld_worker1 2026-07-02.)
- **Drop frame detection / use a raw 1D column-profile shape *hash* (the v49–v53 line):** still scores **0 on hidden** — profiles can't pick the framed key among decoys. NOTE: 1D profiles are fine for frame *localization* (Vamshi), the failure was using them for shape *identity*. SAFE class needs exact 2D verification (Vamshi does it in the bit domain). (captain RED 2026-06-01.)
- **Global color read (ReduceMax over ch2/ch3):** UNSAFE — decoy colored fragments outside the frame (TR3). Read C from the cropped framed interior only.
- **Reduce condition blocks below 4:** DEAD — worst-case shapes need 4 distinct discriminating cells.
- **F16/UINT8 for the OLD ~24000 box-hash chain:** overflow — but moot; the bit-pack paradigm doesn't use those hashes. See `_archive/task182_history.md`.
- **Crop the 16×16 conv hash map (bar is now Boladi's conv-hash 4460, not bit-pack):** DEAD — hand-authored train/test place sprites at rows/cols 0 and 15, so anchors span the FULL [0,15]² range even though the random generator only uses [1,14]. Any spatial crop of the hash/anchor/stamp planes visible-fails. `hash_crop_14x14.md`. (bo_ng_cld_worker1 2026-07-11.)
- **Sparse Conv weight to cut the 250-elem hash kernel params:** DEAD — onnx.checker rejects `sparse_tensor(float)` as Conv W; `sanitize_model` doesn't rename sparse_initializer so the weight input unresolves; a `Constant(sparse_value)` charges its dense output as memory. `sparse_conv_weight.md`. (bo_ng_cld_worker1 2026-07-11.)
- **Narrow F32 intermediates (hash map, profiles, crop) to F16:** DEAD — they are born F32 by Conv/Einsum/Slice; a Cast adds a second charged copy (net +). Only NON-forced small-int coord tensors are shaveable (int32, the 4425 rung).
- **Chase `floor_est ~1200` (prompt's "TopK compaction" framing):** MIS-MODEL — this is a framed-shape-match RECOLOR, not a top-K selection; a static ONNX graph can't emit a variable-length anchor list. Forced 1024 hash + 900 output mask = 1924 alone rules out ~1200. Real floor ≈ 4425. (bo_ng_cld_worker1 2026-07-11.)
